title: FreedomCore Atlas Symbol Coverage & Entity-Resolution Register Schema (v3)

fields.listing_key: Primary key. Exchange- or namespace-qualified canonical identifier (EXCHANGE:TICKER, CRYPTO:SYMBOL, or COINGECKO:ID) across all 6,375 rows.
fields.ticker: Display symbol (e.g., AAPL, SOL, LDO, 1810). Non-unique across borders and asset classes (330 colliding bare-ticker groups across 722 listings); never join on bare ticker.
fields.name: Canonical company or digital asset name from SOURCE_IDENTITY_REGISTER.json.
fields.asset_class: Canonical asset class enum: 'equity' (4,875 rows) or 'crypto' (1,500 rows).
fields.country_code: ISO-3166 alpha-2 country code for sovereign equities (53 countries) or 'GL' for global digital assets.
fields.route_slug: Canonical URL-safe route slug under /stocks/{route_slug}/ (disambiguated for colliding tickers, e.g., SOL, asx-sol, jse-sol, mil-sol, bme-sol).
fields.workstation_url: Direct Research Centre launcher URL keyed by exact listing_key (https://atlas.freedomcore.io/workstation/?symbol={listing_key}).
fields.sec_cik: 10-digit SEC Central Index Key when populated on the canonical register identity (100 equity rows; null in JSON and empty string in CSV otherwise).
fields.coingecko_id: Verified CoinGecko slug when populated on the canonical register identity (1,500 crypto rows; null in JSON and empty string in CSV for equities).
fields.record_exists: Boolean (true/false) indicating whether a stored source-inventory record exists for this listing_key (3,961 true; 2,414 false).
fields.record_state: Explicit stored source-record state enum: 'populated', 'checked_no_signal', 'evidence_collected', 'source_unavailable', or 'record_missing' (never blank).
fields.record_checked_at: Original ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the stored source record was checked (populated on all 3,961 existing records spanning 2026-10-23T06:17:40.161669+00:00 to 2026-10-25T06:38:50.690793+00:00; null in JSON and empty string in CSV on all 2,414 record_missing rows).
fields.record_sha256: 64-hex SHA-256 digest of the stored source record when record_exists is true (3,961 rows; null in JSON and empty string in CSV on all 2,414 record_missing rows).
fields.stored_source_count: Non-negative integer count (0..8, sum 16,155) of primary source entries attached to the stored record.
fields.dated_source_count: Non-negative integer count (0..7, sum 3,173) of primary source entries carrying an explicit publication or filing date.

wrapper_fields.generated_at: Export wrapper generation timestamp ('2026-10-25T09:48:00Z'); individual row check clocks are preserved in records[].record_checked_at.
wrapper_fields.license_url: Canonical Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 license URL.
wrapper_fields.canonical_routes: Map of canonical Atlas public entry points.
wrapper_fields.source_pins: Five SHA-256 digests pinning the underlying catalog, identity register, source inventory summary, terminal Realm review, and writer state.
wrapper_fields.reconciled_counts: Reconciled identity, runtime-admission, hold, stored source-record state, ticker-collision, and issuer/document binding counts.
wrapper_fields.truthfulness_and_copyright_assertions: Boolean assertions enforcing explicit record_missing states, no bare-ticker joins, and zero private/paid prose inclusion.
wrapper_fields.records: Array of 6,375 canonical company and crypto listing records.

clocks.clock_preservation_rule: Original stored source-record check timestamps are preserved verbatim for all 3,961 existing records and remain null (empty in CSV) for all 2,414 record_missing rows.

retired_v1_columns_mapping.symbol: Replaced by primary key 'listing_key' (EXCHANGE:TICKER / CRYPTO:SYMBOL / COINGECKO:ID), display 'ticker', and URL-safe 'route_slug' to eliminate bare-ticker ambiguity across 330 colliding ticker groups.
retired_v1_columns_mapping.context_as_of: Replaced by 'record_checked_at' (original ISO-8601 UTC stored source-record check timestamp) and top-level wrapper 'generated_at'.
retired_v1_columns_mapping.sitemap_lastmod: Retired from per-row register; sitemap timestamps remain in sitemap-index.xml.
